Flatten capsules, keep subtle reniform notch, no spherical berries or leaves. Approximately40-60 visible fertile axis ends,60-110 capsules and24-32 descending root-like axes are explicit low-poly reductions; source estimated many more. Preserve basal horizontal branching and upper forks. No soil disk.
